description: Run any Luau code inside Roblox Studio with full plugin permissions: build or edit instances, read or change any property, call any service, rewrite scripts, import assets. Use `return` to get values back (instances come back as paths, tables as JSON). Everything printed while it runs is returned too. This is the most flexible Studio tool: use it for anything the other tools do not cover.

code.description: Luau source to run. May use return.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result (default 60, max 600). Raise it for long jobs.

name: studio_execute_lua
